extraction.text: Bosch Global Software Technologies Pvt Ltd. Job Description Template Project /Customer Name or Strategic Requirement * DTICI Job title: * IT Infra Architect_System Administrator Work Base Location: * Bangalore Department / Group: * SDS/BSV-IF3 Level: * L83 Experience range: (Min to Max years) * 9-15 years Start Date of the Position/Requirement * 01-04-2025 (April’25 – Mar’26) No. of Positions: * 1 Monthly Bill Rate Range ( for OS candidate) / No. of Months ( as per PO) * / Grade 1 to 4 250000 – 300000 (April’25 – Mar’26) PLW Demand ID: * Additional requirement ( Shift work, Language, Client) 8*5 English Client Projected PO Value  (cost to be paid for vendor) 300000 INR Projected Revenue  (Billing cost) 350000 INR HOP SPOC * Chakrapani Keshava Prakash (SDS/EIF3) TF SPOC Rajesh Kanna J (SX/BSV-IF3) Education and Work Experience Requirements: BE, BTech, BCA, BSc (IT) MCA, MBA (IT) and MSc(IT) Job Description: IT Architect_System Administrator Position Overview: We are seeking a skilled IT Infra architect and System Administrator who will be responsible for for implementing and managing comprehensive IT infrastructure and Integrated Solutions for applications for managed services delivery, ensure adherence of SLAs and security policies and provide technical expertise to the client. Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies (servers, networking, databases), and cloud platforms & application development Experience in Linux/Unix/Windows Administration, AD, SAML, SSO, MFA Experience in network/firewall/load balancer design and implementation.( LDAP, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, HTTPS, APIs) Experience with service management methodologies and tools like ServiceNow. Excellent problem solving, communication & Interpersonal skills interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, build relationship & collaborate with diverse teams. Highly organized, analytical, and procedural with creative and strategic thinking. Adept at managing multiple projects and meeting tight deadlines. Passionate about solution development and automation, actively seeking opportunities to develop tools that streamline and simplify development and delivery processes. Key Responsibilities: 1. Technical Design and Architecture: Design and implement end-to-end systems and solutions for managing IT infrastructure and automating IT managed service delivery. System design should encompass understanding of network, servers (physical and virtual),Interfaces, integration, applications, Data flows, security, and operations. Ensure adherence of best practices and security standards. Reviews the firewall sheets, monitoring configuration sheets and propose changes. Should understand and drive the operations of existing Integrated Application landscape which has for example SAP, Concur, HCM, Vendor Invoice Management System, Service Now etc. 2. Drive Project & Requirement Understand the Technical, Functional and non-functional requirements. Assess the technical feasibility, impact on the infrastructure & identify potential bottlenecks and risks. Foster a high-performing team environment by removing technical roadblocks and guiding team members towards optimal performance. Drive project schedules, deliverables & collaborate with cross-IT teams for implementing IT, Infra and service management solutions. 3. Capacity Planning and Performance Tuning: Estimate resource requirements (CPU, memory, disk, network). Monitor system performance and identify optimization opportunities. Implement performance tuning techniques improve response times and throughput. Ensure efficient use of infrastructure resources support application performance. 4. Problem solver: Detect and diagnose issues that arise at the intersection of application and infrastructure. Work with both teams to develop and implement solutions to these issues. Identify opportunities to optimize the performance of applications through infrastructure improvements. 5. Change Management and Deployment: Oversee application deployments and upgrades. Manage change requests and assess their impact on the infrastructure. Provide management summary for CAB. Coordinate with infrastructure teams to schedule and execute deployments. Plans changes and assign the tasks to various teams and coordinate those tasks. 6. Security and Compliance: Ensure compliance with security policies and industry standards. Identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities. participate in regular security assessments and audits. 7. Knowledge Transfer and Training: Create and maintain documentation for processes that involve both application and infrastructure. Document procedures to facilitate knowledge sharing. Offer training sessions to both teams to ensure they understand the interdependencies and best practices. Foster collaboration and communication between teams. Required Skills and Qualifications: Technical Expertise: Worked extensively in Integrated IT Infra landscape Management, Monitoring & Implementation Strong understanding of systems, networking, development tools, Integrations Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies (servers, networking, databases), and cloud platforms & application development Experience in Linux/Unix/Windows Administration, AD, SAML, SSO, MFA Experience in network/firewall/load balancer design and implementation.( LDAP, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, HTTPS, APIs) Experience with service management methodologies and tools like ServiceNow. Excellent problem solving, communication & Interpersonal skills interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, build relationship & collaborate with diverse teams. Highly organized, analytical, and procedural with creative and strategic thinking. Adept at managing multiple projects and meeting tight deadlines. Passionate about solution development and automation, actively seeking opportunities to develop tools that streamline and simplify development and delivery processes. Hold knowledge on ITIL V4/COBIT5 concepts Very good written and spoken skills Experience: 9-15 years of experience in designing, solutioning and delivery of IT Infra services for global customers. Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent communication and documentation abilities. Certifications (Preferred): Certification as Solution Architect or System administration Certification on Linux would be an advantange. Bosch Payroll: Outsourcing T&M X Outsourcing Work Package: If Outsourcing Selected: Projected PO value to Vendor (in Million): Projected Revenue from Customer (in Million): GDPR relevant Yes /No?:           ( If Yes approved by Customer ?) If Outsourcing Work Package SOW to be shared Interview Panel Details: Screening: Mukundan Shanmugam L1/L2 Technical Panelist: Mukundan Shanmugam Customer Panelist: NA GRM Panelist: Chakrapani Keshava Prakash (SDS/EIF3) / Rajesh Kanna J (SX/BSV-IF3)

Experience Requirements: BE, BTech, BCA, BSc (IT) MCA, MBA (IT) and MSc(IT) Job Description: IT Architect_System Administrator Position Overview: We are seeking a skilled IT Infra architect and System Administrator who will be responsible for for implementing and managing comprehensive IT infrastructure and Integrated Solutions for applications for managed services delivery, ensure adherence of SLAs and security policies and provide technical expertise to the client. Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies (servers, networking, databases), and cloud platforms & application development Experience in Linux/Unix/Windows Administration, AD, SAML, SSO, MFA Experience in network/firewall/load balancer design and implementation.( LDAP, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, HTTPS, APIs) Experience with service management methodologies and tools like ServiceNow. Excellent problem solving, communication & Interpersonal skills interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, build relationship & collaborate with diverse teams. Highly organized, analytical, and procedural with creative and strategic thinking. Adept at managing multiple projects and meeting tight deadlines. Passionate about solution development and automation, actively seeking opportunities to develop tools that streamline and simplify development and delivery processes. Key Responsibilities: 1. Technical Design and Architecture: Design and implement end-to-end systems and solutions for managing IT infrastructure and automating IT managed service delivery. System design should encompass understanding of network, servers (physical and virtual),Interfaces, integration, applications, Data flows, security, and operations. Ensure adherence of best practices and security standards. Reviews the firewall sheets, monitoring configuration sheets and propose changes. Should understand and drive the operations of existing Integrated Application landscape which has for example SAP, Concur, HCM, Vendor Invoice Management System, Service Now etc. 2. Drive Project & Requirement Understand the Technical, Functional and non-functional requirements. Assess the technical feasibility, impact on the infrastructure & identify potential bottlenecks and risks. Foster a high-performing team environment by removing technical roadblocks and guiding team members towards optimal performance. Drive project schedules, deliverables & collaborate with cross-IT teams for implementing IT, Infra and service management solutions. 3. Capacity Planning and Performance Tuning: Estimate resource requirements (CPU, memory, disk, network). Monitor system performance and identify optimization opportunities. Implement performance tuning techniques improve response times and throughput. Ensure efficient use of infrastructure resources support application performance. 4. Problem solver: Detect and diagnose issues that arise at the intersection of application and infrastructure. Work with both teams to develop and implement solutions to these issues. Identify opportunities to optimize the performance of applications through infrastructure improvements. 5. Change Management and Deployment: Oversee application deployments and upgrades. Manage change requests and assess their impact on the infrastructure. Provide management summary for CAB. Coordinate with infrastructure teams to schedule and execute deployments. Plans changes and assign the tasks to various teams and coordinate those tasks. 6. Security and Compliance: Ensure compliance with security policies and industry standards. Identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities. participate in regular security assessments and audits. 7. Knowledge Transfer and 
Experience in Linux/Unix/Windows Administration, AD, SAML, SSO, MFA Experience in network/firewall/load balancer design and implementation.( LDAP, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, HTTPS, APIs) Experience with service management methodologies and tools like ServiceNow. Excellent problem solving, communication & Interpersonal skills interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, build relationship & collaborate with diverse teams. Highly organized, analytical, and procedural with creative and strategic thinking. Adept at managing multiple projects and meeting tight deadlines. Passionate about solution development and automation, actively seeking opportunities to develop tools that streamline and simplify development and delivery processes. Hold knowledge on ITIL V4/COBIT5 concepts Very good written and spoken skills Experience: 9-15 years of experience in designing, solutioning and delivery of IT Infra services for global customers.
